history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration engage the Business Innovation Group in deciding on a streamlined approval process and a revised timeline to ensure that the common back office is implemented and generates the envisaged benefits.
history.administration_response: In line with the Board recommendation, the Development Coordination Office engaged the Assistant Secretaries-General who are members of the Business Innovations Group. At the March 2023 session, a decision was taken to create a new dedicated task team on the Common Back Office. The terms of references of the new task team include a review of the approval process and timelines and plans for accelerated implementation of the Common Back Office. The first meeting of the task team is taking place on 15 April. The Development Coordination Office proposes that this recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration engaged with the Business Innovation Group in 2023 and the terms of reference of a new dedicated task team on the Common Back Office have been launched to accelerate Common Back Office implementation, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
